serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Wow, I really caught something!
Mrs. Fisher: Not bad for your first try, kid.
You: Thank you for teaching me how to do it.
Mrs. Fisher: No biggie, I needed a smoke break anyway.
Mrs. Fisher: So, are you interested in fishing now?
You: A little, but I don’t even have a fishing rod.
Mrs. Fisher: Grab this.
